# Pesher Habakkuk Column 11 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Pesher Habakkuk Column 11 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 11:3 — "power of evil" vs. "grasp of evil" vs. "clutches of disaster"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-power-of evil" | Hebrew kaf ra' — literally "palm of evil" |
| LOGOS | "the grasp of evil" | Preserves hand metaphor |
| PNEUMA | "the clutches of disaster" | Dynamic; "disaster" for ra' |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the power of evil" (EMET). The Hebrew kaf can mean "palm/power"; "evil" for ra' is more faithful than "disaster."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 11:14 — "swallow him up" vs. "destroying him"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "to-swallow-him-up" | Hebrew levall'o — literal |
| LOGOS | "to swallow him up" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "intent on destroying him" | Dynamic interpretation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "to swallow him up" (EMET/LOGOS). The vivid Hebrew metaphor (bala' = swallow) should be preserved, not flattened to "destroy."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 11:17 — "to trip them" vs. "to cause them to stumble" vs. "bring them down"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "to-trip-them" | Compact rendering of Hebrew kashal hif'il |
| LOGOS | "to cause them to stumble" | Formal causative |
| PNEUMA | "bring them down" | Dynamic paraphrase |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "to cause them to stumble." More precise than "trip" (which sounds trivial) and retains causative structure; PNEUMA is too vague.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
*Total disagreements in Column 11: 3 | Covers Hab 2:9-11*
